pr_body:
Today every `BulkProcessor` creates two scheduler threads, both called
`[node-name][scheduler][T#1]`, which is also the name of the main
scheduler thread for the node. The duplicated thread names make it
harder to interpret a thread dump.

This commit makes the names of these threads distinct.

Closes #68470
pr_title: Unique names for bulk processor scheduler threads

review_comment: since this class is the [documented approach](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/client/java-rest/current/java-rest-high-document-bulk.html#java-rest-high-document-bulk-processor) for clients ingestion, can we preserve binary compatibility here ? (i.e. preserve the original method signature and pass an empty/hard-coded string)

Acked, yes, I added the original method back and marked it deprecated so we can remove it at a later date, see 92ea717. The docs from this version onwards use the new method anyway, but of course folk aren't always diligent about reading the docs for the right version so I think it's ok to be lenient here.
